answer: Seed every grading queue with honeypots. Each epoch the protocol secretly slips canary answers into panels: a plagiarized essay, a fluent voyage of prose whose mechanism is nonsense, a velvet template stuffed with the right words. Their correct scores are sealed in advance. Sybil farms survive on cheap graders that rubber-stamp each other, so their seats keep praising canaries and expose themselves; any seat whose canary error rate drifts high loses grading weight and attestation pay. Honest readers who truly wander through each text pass without noticing the test.
